reviewer.identity: Codex independent source, fidelity, and exact-target novelty reviewer
reviewer.focus: all 60 HighamBench task surfaces against their cited papers and the frozen Mathlib/NumStability declarations
reviewer.independence_statement: This review was performed in a fresh review context from the current specification, manifest, task packages, shared definitions, cited paper PDFs, and frozen library sources. I did not read, list, hash, summarize, or rely on any pre-existing review file under paper_bencmark/highambench/metadata/reviews/ and did not rely on prior review conclusions.

artifacts_examined: all 60 current Target.lean, context.md, and task.json task surfaces
all 20 cited local paper PDFs at the task source locators
the 24 frozen mounted NumStability modules and relevant Mathlib source declarations
scope.frozen_numstability_source_check: All 24 modules represented by frozen .olean files matched their entries in library_source.json byte-for-byte by SHA-256.

criteria.source_fidelity: The formal claim must be a valid direct formalization, explicitly signposted finite strengthening, or genuine consequence/specialization of the cited source, with no important source assumption silently removed; the supplied excerpt must explain the intended route.
criteria.exact_target_novelty: Reject when the target's mathematical interface is already discharged by a frozen Mathlib or NumStability declaration after unfolding paper-scoped aliases, definitional normalization, and only condition-neutral elementary arithmetic. Nearby reusable lemmas are not collisions when a genuinely paper-specific composition remains.
criteria.release_policy: Any retained exact-target collision blocks public release. A private measurement may ignore only those novelty rejections when source_faithful is true, as implemented by refresh_snapshot.py.

private_measurement_override_compatibili.rationale: Every rejection below is source-faithful and is explicitly marked fail_exact_target_collision with at least one exact-target absence flag false. No source-fidelity rejection is being overridden.
